evidence_contract.confirmed_tower: Only public-source text explicitly matching cooling tower/cooling towers.
evidence_contract.related_equipment: Evaporative condenser is confirmed related equipment but is not relabeled as a cooling tower.
evidence_contract.supporting: Chiller, condenser-water, and chemical-feed references are supporting commercial/mechanical context only.
evidence_contract.absence: No matching record is not evidence that a property lacks a cooling tower.

join_contract.tower_semantics: RentSafeTO never creates or upgrades cooling-tower status.
join_contract.cooling_room_semantics: RentSafeTO cooling-room fields are retained only as building context and are not cooling-tower evidence.

permit_timing_contract.source_active: Record is present in the City of Toronto Active Permits dataset; this does not by itself mean recent buying activity.
permit_timing_contract.recent_activity: Source-active permit record with a usable event date no more than 365 days before POC generation.
permit_timing_contract.old_source_active_records: Retained as equipment/project evidence but not represented as recent activity.

tower_lifecycle_contract.classification_basis: Deterministic phrases in explicit public permit descriptions; no model inference.
tower_lifecycle_contract.current_presence_caveat: A permit can describe existing, proposed, replaced, or removed equipment. CONFIRMED means explicit documentary tower evidence, not guaranteed current post-project tower presence.

potential_project_aliases.interpretation: Identical recent permit description appears at multiple addresses; do not assume independent commercial opportunities without project-level reconciliation.
